blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Roof Restoration Cost in Melbourne in 2026?
blogPosts.excerpt: Wondering about the cost of restoring your roof in Melbourne? We break down the factors, from materials to roof size, plus current price ranges for Southbank homes.
body: Roof restoration is a smart investment for Melbourne homeowners, especially in suburbs like Southbank where older homes often have heritage tiles. But the big question is always cost. In 2026, a typical roof restoration in Melbourne ranges between $4,000 and $10,000 depending on roof size, material, and condition. Factors like scaffolding access, repointing, and colour coating also affect the final price.

The first step is getting a professional inspection. At Everlast Home Improvements, we offer free onsite assessments to evaluate your roof's condition. A thorough inspection will reveal if you need simple repairs, a full clean and seal, or a complete restoration. Ignoring minor issues can lead to bigger problems – and higher costs – down the track, especially after a Melbourne storm.

Material choice plays a big role in cost. Concrete tiles are common in Southbank and are relatively affordable to restore – typically $30 to $50 per square metre for cleaning and sealing. Terracotta tiles cost more due to their fragility and the need for specialised sealants. Metal roofs, while less common in older homes, are cheaper to restore but may require rust treatment and repainting.

Labour costs in Melbourne have risen slightly in 2026, with most roofers charging between $50 and $80 per hour. A typical restoration takes 3 to 5 days, so labour can account for 30-40% of the total. Always choose a licensed and insured roofer – cheap quotes often mean cutting corners, which voids warranties and leaves you unprotected.

Many homeowners ask us whether restoration is cheaper than replacement. In most cases, yes – restoration can extend the life of your roof by 15 to 20 years for a fraction of the cost of a full replacement. However, if the underlying structure is compromised, replacement becomes necessary. We always advise based on what's best for your home, not our bottom line.

At Everlast, we provide fixed-price quotes with no hidden fees. Our roof restoration package includes pressure cleaning, repairs, resealing, and a 10-year leak-proof warranty. Contact us today for a free onsite assessment in Southbank or anywhere in Melbourne. Your roof is your home's first line of defence – don't wait until the next storm to take action.

blogPosts.title: Signs Your Roof Needs Repair Before Winter Hits
blogPosts.excerpt: Melbourne winters can be brutal on roofs. Learn the warning signs of damage and how to prevent costly leaks before the cold and rain arrive.
body: Melbourne's winter is notorious for sudden downpours, strong winds, and hailstorms. If your roof has existing weaknesses, winter will expose them fast. The most common signs that your roof needs repair include water stains on ceilings, cracked or missing tiles, sagging rooflines, and granules in your gutters. Ignoring these can lead to mould, structural damage, and expensive emergency callouts.

Start by checking your ceiling for brown or yellow water stains, especially after a heavy rain. These indicate moisture seeping through the roof membrane. In Southbank's older homes, flashing around chimneys and vents is often the culprit. A quick repair now can save you thousands in restoration later. Our team at Everlast can inspect and fix these issues before winter sets in.

Next, inspect your roof tiles. Concrete and terracotta tiles can crack or slip over time due to Melbourne's temperature extremes. Look for broken, displaced, or moss-covered tiles. If you notice daylight from the roof cavity, you have a leak waiting to happen. Replacing a few tiles is cheap – replacing a rotted roof frame is not. Regular maintenance is key.

Your gutters are another critical area. Clogged or sagging gutters cause water to back up under the roof edge, leading to rot and leaks. Clean them out and check for rust, especially on metal roofs. Downpipes should be secure and directing water away from the foundation. We offer roof plumbing services to keep your drainage system in top shape.

Don't forget the roof interior. If you have access to your attic or ceiling cavity, look for damp insulation, mould growth, or daylight through the roof deck. These are red flags. Also check for animal nests – possums and birds love warm roof spaces and can cause damage. A pre-winter inspection gives you peace of mind and keeps your home safe and dry.

At Everlast Home Improvements, we specialise in pre-winter roof inspections and repairs. Our licensed team will identify every potential problem and give you a fixed-price quote on the spot. Serving Southbank and all of Melbourne, we ensure your roof is ready for whatever winter throws at it. Book your free onsite assessment today and sleep easy through the cold months.

blogPosts.title: Tile vs Metal Roofing – Which is Best for Melbourne Homes?
blogPosts.excerpt: Choosing between tile and metal roofing? We compare durability, cost, insulation, and appearance for Melbourne's climate, with a focus on Southbank homes.
body: One of the biggest decisions Melbourne homeowners face is choosing between tile and metal roofing. Both have pros and cons, and the right choice depends on your budget, style, and how long you plan to stay in your home. In Southbank, you'll see a mix of both, with older homes favouring terracotta tiles and newer builds opting for Colorbond steel.

Tile roofing – concrete or terracotta – has been the traditional choice for decades. It offers excellent thermal mass, keeping homes cooler in summer and warmer in winter. Terracotta tiles are particularly beautiful on Federation-style homes. However, tiles are heavier and require a strong roof frame. They can also crack under extreme weather, though repairs are straightforward.

Metal roofing, especially Colorbond, is lightweight, durable, and fire-resistant – a big plus in bushfire-prone areas around Melbourne. It's also more energy-efficient when combined with reflective coatings. Metal roofs last 40-60 years with minimal maintenance. The downside is that they can be noisier in heavy rain, though modern insulation largely solves this. They also dent more easily from hail.

Cost-wise, metal roofing is generally cheaper to install than high-end terracotta tiles, but comparable to concrete tiles. A standard Colorbond roof for a three-bedroom home costs between $8,000 and $15,000 installed, while concrete tiles range from $10,000 to $18,000. Terracotta can go higher. Maintenance costs are lower for metal, but replacement costs are higher for tiles.

In Melbourne's variable climate, both options perform well. Tiles offer a classic look and natural insulation, while metal excels in longevity and low maintenance. Many Southbank homeowners choose tile for character homes and metal for modern extensions. At Everlast, we install both and can advise based on your specific roof structure, council requirements, and aesthetic preferences.

Whatever you choose, proper installation is critical. Poorly installed roofs leak, no matter the material. At Everlast Home Improvements, we use licensed tradesmen and high-quality materials on every job. We serve Southbank and greater Melbourne. Contact us for a free consultation – we'll help you pick the best roofing solution for your home and budget.

blogPosts.title: Emergency Roof Repairs – What to Do When a Storm Hits Southbank
blogPosts.excerpt: Storms can strike without warning. Know exactly what to do if your roof is damaged, and how Everlast's 24/7 emergency team can help fast.
body: Melbourne storms are unpredictable. One minute it's clear, the next a hailstorm or gale-force wind has damaged your roof. If you find yourself with a leaking roof, broken tiles, or worse – a tree through the roof – staying calm and acting fast is essential. At Everlast Home Improvements, we offer 24/7 emergency repairs across Southbank and Melbourne.

First, ensure your family's safety. If water is coming in, move furniture and valuables away from the affected area. Place buckets to catch drips and use towels to soak up water. If there's a large hole or structural damage, consider evacuating that part of the house. Your safety comes first – never climb onto a damaged roof yourself.

Next, try to minimise further damage. If you have a tarpaulin, cover the damaged area from the outside if it's safe to do so. Otherwise, focus on containing the water inside. Turn off electricity to rooms where water is near switches or appliances. Take photos of the damage for insurance purposes – your insurer will need evidence.

Call a professional roofer immediately. Don't wait until morning – a small leak can turn into massive water damage overnight. At Everlast, our emergency team answers calls 24/7. We'll send a licensed roofer to your Southbank home within hours, not days. We'll assess the damage, do temporary repairs to secure your roof, and provide a fixed-price quote for permanent fixes.

Once the immediate crisis is handled, work with your insurance company. Most policies cover storm damage, but you need to act quickly. Our team can provide detailed reports and invoices to support your claim. We also handle the permanent repairs – from tile replacement to full section restoration – ensuring your roof is back to original condition.

Prevention is better than cure. After any storm, have your roof inspected even if you don't see obvious damage. Hail can cause hairline cracks that leak months later. At Everlast Home Improvements, we offer free post-storm inspections for Southbank and Melbourne homes. Don't wait – storm season is here. Save our number: 0404 732 863. We're here when you need us.
